response.content: {"keypoints": [{"category": "benefit", "point": "Keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours and hot for up to 12 hours when filled to the top with lid closed at 22\u00b0C room temperature"}, {"category": "spec", "point": "Body is 18/8 stainless steel; lid is BPA-free polypropylene with silicone seal"}, {"category": "other", "point": "Hand wash the body with warm water and mild soap; lid is top-rack dishwasher safe; do not put body in dishwasher, freezer or microwave"}, {"category": "proof", "point": "Tested with 40 office workers in Seoul for two weeks \u2014 one tester wrote: \"I finally drink water at my desk because it is still cold at 4 pm\""}, {"category": "spec", "point": "Holds 500 ml and weighs 310 g empty; fits most car cup holders and backpack side pocket"}, {"category": "price_or_terms", "point": "November launch price is 28,000 won instead of 32,000 won; two-year warranty against vacuum seal defects"}, {"category": "other", "point": "Order online at sol-studio.example or visit Seongsu-dong pop-up on weekends in November; first 50 pop-up customers get a free carry strap"}]}
